about: One key sentence per founder ruling on the Engineer. `npm run engineer:rulings` checks each is on the wire — in the working tree by default, or in any saved commit with --ref (origin/main is what production builds, origin/beta is the beta site). Written 2026-09-19 after a whole round of rulings (2026-09-04) was found never to have reached main. Add a line whenever a ruling lands. `present` must appear in the file; `absent` must NOT. Whitespace and line wrapping are ignored.

rulings.ruling: Damper oil moves in 50 cSt steps
rulings.present: step: "50 cSt"

rulings.ruling: No net outranks another; choose by fit, never by wording
rulings.present: Every entry carries the same weight

rulings.ruling: A roll-centre direction can never be stated backwards (code check on every reply)
rulings.present: export function rcGuardCorrections

rulings.ruling: One question per reply, not per conversation
rulings.present: never more than one in a reply

rulings.ruling: "No change worth making" is an allowed answer
rulings.present: or instead of it when there is no change worth making

rulings.ruling: Questions are asked in the driver's words too, not only changes
rulings.present: A change, and a question, is what the driver will feel and where on the corner

rulings.ruling: Other levers: the 4 Sept "at most three" cap stays gone; a problem gets the other main levers (founder: "yes", 2026-09-24)
rulings.absent: then other levers that would also do it, at most three

rulings.ruling: No banned-word list (it had banned "lazy")
Feel words pass one test: would a driver say it
rulings.present: would a driver say it about how the car behaves

rulings.ruling: "More rolled-in" is not a driver's word
Corner places are entering / turning in, in the middle, exiting
rulings.present: `entering` / `turning in`, `in the middle`, `exiting`

rulings.present: A balance word names a ratio, not an end

rulings.ruling: Levers are grouped into families (roll stiffness, roll centre, response)

rulings.present: A corner named is a phase given

rulings.present: Two changes can share one test

rulings.ruling: The first answer names what the lead change costs and stops there; the fix waits for the driver's ask, on a button — replaces 2026-09-09's paired change (founder: "Yes")
rulings.present: what it costs, one clause, and nothing yet about getting that back: that waits until they ask

rulings.present: IT GOES EITHER WAY

rulings.present: often feels like more rear grip and less rotation, even in the middle of the corner

rulings.ruling: Whole-car moves exist as BOTH ENDS TOGETHER lines

rulings.ruling: Thinner oil both ends can feel like LESS overall grip
rulings.present: because it reacts so quickly it can feel like less overall grip
